cotton.name: Cotton

sources.kc_and_stages: Kc ini/mid/end checked against FAO-56 Table 12; stage lengths checked against Table 11 where a row exists (see each crop's stages_source); hairy vetch, rye, clover, chickpea, rapeseed have no Table 11 row (author's estimate); hairy vetch and cereal-rye cover Kc are analogues (approx)
sources.ky: FAO-33 seasonal Ky (Table 1 of FAO paper 66 reproduces it) where listed; otherwise fallback 0.6+0.9*(1-drought_tol), flagged approx
sources.gdd_base_cotton: 15.5 C = cotton DD60 convention, from memory; FAO paper 66 does not state a cotton base temperature
sources.temperature: FAO ECOCROP-style ranges (t_min, t_opt, t_max); cover crops from extension-service guidance
sources.gdd: GDD base and requirement approximate, from cultivar-group literature (modified method, cap 30 C)
sources.trait_scores: cover/om/forage/income/drought/salinity: 0-1 authors' relative estimates (income index 1 ~ USD 600-700/ha gross margin, rough; cover crops are negative = seed+termination cost; cover-crop forage halved because it is not a harvested crop)
sources.n_credit: approx. net N credit to the following crop, kg N/ha (extension-service ranges)
sources.sow_doy: typical sowing window, day of year, mid-latitude northern hemisphere (Central Asia / US Plains)

sources.trait_scores: cover/om/forage/income/drought/salinity: 0-1 authors' relative estimates (income index 1 ~ USD 600-700/ha gross margin, rough; cover crops are negative = seed+termination cost; cover-crop forage halved because it is not a harvested crop)
sources.n_credit: approx. net N credit to the following crop, kg N/ha (extension-service ranges)
sources.sow_doy: typical sowing window, day of year, mid-latitude northern hemisphere (Central Asia / US Plains)

sugar_beet.name: Sugar beet
sugar_beet.market_note: Needs a sugar factory within reach; contract-based.

sources.kc_and_stages: Kc ini/mid/end checked against FAO-56 Table 12; stage lengths checked against Table 11 where a row exists (see each crop's stages_source); hairy vetch, rye, clover, chickpea, rapeseed have no Table 11 row (author's estimate); hairy vetch and cereal-rye cover Kc are analogues (approx)
sources.ky: FAO-33 seasonal Ky (Table 1 of FAO paper 66 reproduces it) where listed; otherwise fallback 0.6+0.9*(1-drought_tol), flagged approx
sources.gdd_base_cotton: 15.5 C = cotton DD60 convention, from memory; FAO paper 66 does not state a cotton base temperature
